snippet.title: Space Warpster - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
OUT NOW on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4426550/Space_Warpster/

Get ready for takeoff! We are thrilled to unveil the official trailer for Space Warpster! 🚀

After months of hard work at AMAMiZU games, we’re almost ready to bring our retro-arcade vision to life. Space Warpster is a high-energy shooter inspired by the golden age of gaming, packed with intense bullet-hell patterns, tactical power-ups, and a massive original electronic soundtrack to keep your adrenaline pumping.

Key Features:
● Classic Arcade Action: Fast-paced gameplay with a modern twist.
● Strategic Depth: Time-limited powerups that change how you approach every wave.
● Steam Achievements: Prove your piloting mastery and unlock every challenge in the galaxy!
● Built for Competitors: Climb the global rankings with full Steam Leaderboard support.
● Your Playstyle: Customizable difficulty levels and tight, responsive controls.
● Stay Safe: Full Steam Cloud Save support.

Huge thanks to everyone who played the demo and shared their feedback - your support helped us shape this final experience. We can’t wait to see you on the leaderboards!

#SpaceWarpster #indiegame #shmup #retrogaming #indiedev #GodotEngine #arcade #gaming
